description: This source file implements classes and functions for reporting distribution predictions in media learning, including UMA histogram and UKM recording, specifically for distribution reporting and confusion matrix analysis.

classes.name: UmaRegressionReporter
classes.description: Handles reporting of regression predictions via UMA histograms, including confusion matrix analysis and feature-based bucketing.

classes.name: UkmRegressionReporter
classes.description: Handles reporting of regression predictions via UKM, including bucketing of observed and predicted values.

methods.name: OnPrediction
methods.description: Processes prediction info and target histogram, records confusion matrix data via UMA or UKM.

methods.name: Bucketize
methods.description: Converts a continuous value into a scaled bucket index for reporting.
